assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only re-zero:liliana-masquerade@light-novel#character-model, the canonical generation V1.1 Liliana Masquerade V01-V19 source-bounded character model at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the admitted Japanese main light novels; the model declares that it integrates actual appearances and attributed retrospects from targeted revisits of already consumed V04, V10 and V16-V19 and that the V01-V19 label is a horizon, not an appearance in every volume. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method, authority order, gate state and scope only. The frozen volume readings, the five specialist ledgers and master ledger, the source lock, the original V1.0 fidelity review, the separate V1.1 confidence/fidelity reassessment, the reconstruction protocol and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them; the model's MONOGRAPH_READY label, its PASS_WITH_BOUND local verdict and its HIGH/MEDIUM rule confidences are inputs, not conclusions. No V20 or later volume, manor side story, web-novel, IF, supplement or adaptation material is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's default, living RZ-E-021 at Kiritaka's canal retrieval after the V19 tower collapse, before unshown transport or waking, in which no new awake reply is established; plus its twelve explicit override selectors from remembered childhood (age ten), the departure at thirteen and the silent crossing at seventeen through the V16 reunion and refusal, the V17 E019/E020/E021 park states, the V18 alley, shelters and council and the V19 approach, performance and retrieval, each with knowledge, relationship and body rollbacks. Childhood and early travel are known only through her V19 adult retrospect; discarded E018-E020 branches are Subaru's memory, not hers. No state after the V19 retrieval is established and no in-world dates are fixed.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states a governing argument (song as a gift that need not own its hearer, coexisting with appetite for applause, comfort, money and a newest legend; section 1), an attention and knowledge account separating hearing from knowing (section 5) and twenty-two conditional rules with trigger, counterevidence and per-rule confidence (section 9), routed to eighteen located bundles with block ranges. It is one same-analyst artifact for a supporting character whose mainline presence is essentially the V16-V19 Pristella arc; R04, R08 and R20 are MEDIUM and must stay conditional in unfamiliar situations, and family motive is attributed rather than known, so B is not supported; the explicit rule structure with exceptions exceeds distributed evidence, so D is not supported.

Section 4 traces development from the ten-year-old's wish through the departure at thirteen, the caravan year, the declined invitation, the illness reorientation and city life, and section 2 supplies twelve phase selectors with knowledge, relationship and body rollbacks; R11 separates the induced Sirius affiliation from the later rejection. Everything before V16 rests on her own V19 retrospect (E15-E16) and the observed arc is one city crisis across V16-V19, so B is not supported; the state firewalls are explicit and located, so D is not supported.

Section 8 organizes register by condition (familiar banter, serious vocation, excitement, fear, artistic challenge, performance, depletion) with located contrasts at V16 p-008#B0063-0075, p-018#B0146-0153 and V19 p-006#B0041-0056, and quotes a few exact forms (the honorifics ナツキ様, エミリア様, プリシラ様 and キリタカさん, 幼女様, いぃえぇ, 図々しいですよぅ and the song title 朝焼けを追い越す空). The register is described far more than quoted, no lexical or sentence-ending inventory exists and the model warns against a repeated catchphrase, so C is not supported; the conditions are located and contrasted, so E is not supported.

Section 7 and bundles E03-E06, E12 and E15-E17 locate paid performance, the inherited instrument and its V16 drop, the first-tip amulet, caravan work, the soft city bed, applause, the refreshments proposal and the dress fastening, each paired with a stated limit (no favorite dessert, earnings, address, sleep schedule or domestic routine); R16 and R20 model them, R20 only at MEDIUM. The ordinary scenes are a handful within a crisis arc, so B is not supported; they are located and rule-structured, so D is not supported.

Section 6 differentiates Subaru, Emilia and Beatrice, Priscilla, Kiritaka, audiences, family and unknown recipients, with multi-scene recipient-specific conduct for Priscilla (accepted refusal, pressured council assent, dress permission, imposed kiss, title lapse) and Kiritaka (patronage, discomfort at his gaze, assumed death, retrieval and teasing), modeled by R14 and R15. Family relations are a single retrospect with an unnamed sister, Emilia and Beatrice rest on few scenes and the model's matched-recipient comparisons are documentary rather than controlled, so B is not supported; two relations carry located multi-phase conditioning, so D is not supported.

Section 8 records that first-person patter at the opening of V19 p-004 and at the canal ending, and the adult retrospective of V19 p-006, give access to her presentation and internal experience, including the private final thought of being glad to be his songstress (E18) and the illness reorientation (E16). Outside those V19 passages interior claims are inferred from action, and the model keeps the narrator's awakening explanation apart from her knowledge, so B is not supported; there is direct located interior access, unlike a never-focalized subject, so D is not supported.

Located conflict includes the failed intercession and disrupted negotiation (E04), the respectful refusal of Priscilla's service (E06), the pride-triggered pressured assent at the council (E11), the struggle against the imposed kiss (E13), the artistic challenge to Sirius's imposed sameness (E14) and varied responses to criticism, modeled by R05, R06, R14 and R18 with fear, retreat behind a protector and rash suggestions retained. The responses come from one arc and R18 is a disjunction of observed reactions rather than a selector, so B is not supported; the conflict set is multi-recipient and rule-structured, so D is not supported.

The evidence supplies reasoned stances in her own voice or retrospect: song as a gift that does not require reciprocity after the illness (E16), the remembered refusal to make song a tool and the chosen continued shelter rounds (E10, B0476), the vocational refusal of service (E06) and the rejection of coerced unity on musical grounds (E14). It shows no scene of weighing competing moral claims, the council assent is pressured rather than deliberated, and the model offers no ethical selector beyond R05 and R10, so C is not supported; the stated reasons exceed bare located acts, so E is not supported.

Her own comic play recurs across V16 and V19: the spontaneous duet, extravagant banter and inflated courtesy, the excited instrument flourish, the age misreading of Beatrice, tongue biting, the comic family insistence and the teasing of Kiritaka at the canal, described in sections 4, 6 and 8 with the warning that a comic sound does not make pain unreal. The repertoire is described more than quoted and is confined to one arc, so B is not supported; it is recurrent, located and constrained, so D is not supported.

The model declares the admitted Japanese V01-V19 horizon, excludes V20, side-story, web-novel, IF, supplement and adaptation material, routes each bundle to a frozen volume reading and exact member and block range, records 3,392 revisited positions and six viewed images as traceability measurements rather than rereadings, and states that a zero literal-name search does not prove the absence of unnamed appearances. The readings, ledgers, source lock and EPUBs are outside this evidence set and the series continues past V19, so B is not supported; the boundary is exact and located, so D is not supported.

Affirmative located limitations: the failed intercession and promise distortion (E04), the instrument drop (E03), the dismissed real age of Beatrice and her refused hand fussing (E02, E07), the reckless rejected decapitation proposal and the dangerous medical claim (E09), the induced favorable judgment of Sirius and the mistaken instant-killing suggestion (E13), the mistaken belief that Kiritaka is dead (E11-E13), not understanding the Priscilla-Anastasia exchange (E12) and the unaware awakening (E17); section 10 lists fifteen falsifiers of particular stronger models. All of it lives in one artifact and the control application is the project's own same-analyst review, so A is not supported; these are located counterinstances rather than gaps, so C is not supported.

Section 2 fixes seven coordinates at a precisely bounded default (actual retrieval, announced sleep, promised but unperformed transport, a private future-oriented wish that is not the next spoken line) and twelve override selectors with exclusions; the restoration point is placed at the second-song proposal, discarded branches are Subaru's memory, the V16 name acquisition is timed at p-008#B0107-0109, and the existing gift's awakening is separated from its earlier naming. The childhood chronology is approximate retrospect, in-volume order depends on the uncurated event-state ledger and the artifact is single, so A is not supported; the firewalls are explicit and located, so C is not supported.

scenario_readiness.note: The register is organized by condition but attested in only a few exact forms, the default state is asleep and supports no new awake answer, and section 8 itself warns that fidelity is not a repeated catchphrase. CONDITIONAL would license lines that are mostly invention organized by a register table; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located register contrasts, which do support recognizing and constraining a line. This bounds the evidence set, not Liliana's speech.

conditions: An awake phase among the model's override selectors is explicitly chosen with its knowledge, relationship and body rollbacks; the default canal-retrieval state yields abstention, never a new awake reply.

The interlocutor is an attested relation (Subaru, Emilia, Beatrice, Priscilla, Kiritaka, an audience or shelter listeners) in the register and knowledge the phase allows; a new recipient receives at most conventional politeness or a proposed performance, never a fabricated shared history.
Output is labeled NONCANONICAL_PROBE, follows the rule's stated confidence, keeps R04, R08 and R20 conditional, and retains the fear, misjudgment and dependence the source shows.
Unrepresented biography, the sister's and suitor's identities, parental motives, the awakening's technical scope, lyrics and any outcome after the V19 retrieval end in abstention.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named phase between the V16 Pristella reunion and the V19 retrieval before sleep, or an explicitly selected remembered phase from her V19 retrospect used only as recollection; by default the latest state is asleep and supports no new action.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Subaru as familiar acquaintance and prospective legend subject without knowledge of his loops, Emilia and Beatrice as appreciative listeners, Priscilla as valued partner and pressuring protector, Kiritaka as patron in the phase-appropriate mix of praise, discomfort and reliance, or audiences and shelter listeners; strangers only as audience or recipients of an offered performance.
setting_constraints: Pristella streets, broadcast, shelters, council, tower and canal settings of V16-V19, or travelling-performance contexts the retrospect attests
No institution, technology or cultural assumption outside the admitted Japanese V01-V19 main light novels
No new powers, complete Wrath or gift mechanics, or fresh singing capacity in a depleted phase
Open domains end in abstention rather than prediction

scenario_readiness.note: Section 10 classifies every unfamiliar application as NONCANONICAL_PROBE, requires holding the request and phase constant when varying a recipient, and lists abstentions; section 9 supplies rule-level exceptions with confidence. Readiness is conditional because three rules are MEDIUM, family and Kiritaka outcomes are open and the model tests itself only through a same-analyst documentary review. READY would treat the probe design as validation; NOT_READY would deny an explicit, state-bound application protocol.

conditions: Scenes of attested kinds only: public performance for wages or applause, proposing song and refreshments for conversation, handling the inherited instrument, enjoying praise or comfort, or a specified small task such as fastening a dress with permission.
No favorite dessert, diet, earnings, address, sleep schedule or private domestic routine is supplied.
Touch and access are recipient- and permission-specific; Priscilla's dress permission grants no access to Liliana's own body, and Beatrice's refusal of hand fussing is retained.
An awake phase is selected explicitly; nothing ordinary is attributed to the sleeping default.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary conduct is located (paid performance, applause, the refreshments proposal, the soft bed, the first-tip amulet) and modeled by R16 and R20, but R20 is MEDIUM and the model refuses favorites, earnings and routines. READY would invent a domestic routine; NOT_READY would deny the located ordinary scenes.

Reasoned stances about her vocation exist (song as gift, refusal to make song a tool, rejection of coerced unity) but no weighing of competing moral claims is shown and the model supplies no procedure for a new moral choice. CONDITIONAL would generalize vocational stances into deliberation; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located reasons.

conditions: Toward Kiritaka only, in a named phase from V16 patronage through the V19 retrieval; no other romantic relation is attested and the unnamed suitor and marriage invitation are not a recurring contact.
Her private wish to say she is glad to be his songstress is unspoken; no confession, accepted marriage, exclusivity or later talk is asserted.
Her remembered discomfort at his gaze, the sleeping-access boundary and her challenge to his presumptuous love claim stay live.
The imposed kiss is not prior assent, a couple or a romance with Priscilla, and no V20 or later material resolves anything.
scenario_readiness.note: The Kiritaka relation is located across phases with discomfort, gratitude, assumed death, retrieval, teasing and a private future-oriented warmth, and R15 conditions it on his act and phase; the imposed Priscilla kiss is recorded as nonconsensual with mixed later response, not a romance. READY would settle a couple the text leaves open; NOT_READY would erase the located, recipient-specific development.

conditions: Contexts of the kinds narrated: street performance and crowd calming, civic broadcast with Kiritaka's equipment, shelter singing rounds, caravan performance work and the protected Fourth stage.
Her help has a domain: song, guidance, encouragement or a call for assistance; no surgery, diplomacy, escort strength or complete apology is added.
The Fourth performance depends on Priscilla's protection, finite gems and a protected route, and costs pain and stamina; the awakening is not self-understood.
She is a travelling bard, not a sworn retainer, royal knight or civic commander, and the vocational refusal of permanent service holds.
scenario_readiness.note: Bardic work is the best-covered domain (E02-E05, E10, E14, E16-E17) and R02, R05, R09 and R12 model vocation, refusal, help and costly performance. READY would hand her universal civic command or mastery of the gift; NOT_READY would deny the located performance contexts.

known_limits.statement: The model's default is living RZ-E-021 after Kiritaka's canal retrieval, with depleted voice and strength, announced sleep, promised but unperformed transport and a conditional promise of later talk; no waking reply, safe arrival or recovery is shown, and any dialogue requires an explicitly selected earlier waking phase rather than an invented wake-up.

Subaru's discarded square deaths, the E020-only head-butt exchange and Liliana's differing failed-branch responses are not her E021 memories; she does not know his Return by Death, his private reason for postponing his story or the lost Rem identity by familiarity.

Reinhard identifies her existing gift 伝心 in V18; in V19 it roots and opens without her awareness and without anyone explaining it to her there. She cannot deliver a technical account of the awakening, its range or a counter-Wrath procedure, and the transferred mirror is equipment, not innate telepathy.

Her family account is her own attributed retrospect; the girl at the silent crossing is only inferred to be her sister and is unnamed, the marriage invitation's proposer is unidentified, parental motives are not known, and the husband-and-ten-children image at V19 B0192 is an unrealized counterfactual.

The Kiritaka relation ends in relief, teasing and a private future-oriented wish without a spoken confession or settlement, and his earlier gaze remains remembered as uncomfortable; the imposed Priscilla kiss followed struggle, and later pleasure or embarrassment does not supply prior assent.

The model's PASS_WITH_BOUND verdict is a same-analyst nonblind documentary reassessment of V1.1, not an independent, held-out, runtime or global grade; HIGH and MEDIUM rate source support for a bounded rule, not response likelihood, and both the model header and the project entrypoint record the pair's own full publication gate as pending at basis.

The frozen V04-V19 deep readings, the event, knowledge, mechanics, institution and relationship ledgers, the master ledger, the source lock, the reconstruction protocol, the original and current fidelity reviews and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject, so the model's block locators and image views were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
